prompt_exact.distance:
Create original environment game art for ChirpNeighbors, one production layer only. LANDSCAPE 1536 x 1024 canvas, all three separate images share exactly this coordinate contract. Naturalistic detailed PIXEL ART with clearly connected square-pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes: coherent value bands, selective highlights, varied organic shapes and branch gaps. Pixel art should visibly read as square-pixel clusters at normal scale; no uniformly noisy stipple, no smooth vector shapes, no high-resolution painterly airbrush, no bloom. Near edge accents dark olive/brown, distance pale blue-gray, muted mustard/ochre/olive mid foliage. Atmospheric overlap and simpler distant planes. Soft diffuse upper-left marine-morning light; shadows consistently cast softly lower-right. Quiet broad central/lower-middle bird stage is the visual priority, so background is restrained and birds/contacts can carry the highest contrast later. Original small San Diego outdoor courtyard layout, not a panoramic patio, not a natural water landscape. No birds, animals, people, boats, lake, alpine mountains, furniture, installed feeder/bath, text, labels, UI, watermark or thick decorative border. The reference guidance is analyst text only; no source image is supplied or used for image conditioning.

OPAQUE SKY AND DISTANCE BASE. A compact San Diego coastal urban courtyard at diffuse marine morning. Broad pale blue-gray luminous sky opening from x=200 to x=1320 in upper 45 percent; small quiet muted rooftop silhouettes near y=470, a few small desaturated olive distant canopy masses near the sides, varied heights and gaps. Distant shapes are simple broad connected clusters with much softer contrast than foreground; no prominent skyline or centered focal object. Bottom half should remain a very calm pale-gray-green atmospheric underpaint with no close objects, to be covered later by a separate ground plate. Do NOT include near walls, garden borders, lawn, pavers, trunks or foreground foliage. Opaque entire canvas, no transparency. This is intentionally an unfinished distance plate, not the whole yard.

Along the boundary foot near y=620 put a SHALLOW garden border: small restrained olive and muted ochre foliage masses only, with varied heights and gaps, not a thick hedge. From y=660 all the way to the bottom and full canvas width, one continuous mostly opaque clear muted sage-green short lawn with a few quiet buff ground seams near side edges. Low texture variation, natural ground shading and sparse tiny pixel clusters. Reserve x=350..1220,y=700..980 for a broad empty low-contrast bird/contact stage.
